import_pytorch_module_via_aotautograd: import a PyTorch module into a dataflow graph using TorchGraphImporter with AOTAutograd in eval or train mode
import_pytorch_module_via_fx_tracer: import a PyTorch module into a dataflow graph using TorchGraphImporter with a custom FX tracer class
compute_optimal_schedule: compute an optimal node execution schedule using training_graph_optimizer.Scheduler to minimize peak memory usage
reorder_fx_graph_nodes: reorder FX graph nodes using FXOptimizer.Reorder with an optimized node ordering from the scheduler
profile_fx_graph_memory: profile peak memory allocation of an FX graph using fx_profiler.ProfilingInterpreter with warm-up and profile iterations
